- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

## What does this PR do?

Fail the existing linting job when a Python file under `megatron/core` imports `megatron.training` or one of its submodules. Run Ruff's `TID251` rule over the entire core tree after installing the existing linting tools, emitting GitHub file/line annotations. Declare the `megatron` namespace package so relative imports are also checked, and ignore `noqa` suppressions for this check.

This adds no dependencies and leaves the existing formatting checks unchanged. Runtime imports through `importlib` are outside this static check's coverage.

## Existing violations

**This draft is expected to fail the new lint step until the existing violations are removed.** On the current `main` baseline, Ruff reports four imports in `megatron/core/inference/text_generation_server/dynamic_text_gen_server/vlm_dynamic_inference.py`, lines 23–26: `get_args`, `get_model`, `print_rank_0`, and the checkpoint-loading helpers. This PR adds enforcement only; it does not exempt or refactor those imports.

## Validation

- Executed the command parsed from the workflow with locked Ruff 0.9.10: exit 1 and exactly four expected GitHub error annotations for the existing violations.
- Passed 18 temporary positive/negative fixtures covering absolute and relative imports, aliases, submodules, multiline imports, function-local and conditional imports, type-checking imports, suppressed imports, allowed core imports, similar module names, comments, and strings.
- Workflow YAML parsing and shell syntax checks passed.
- Actionlint v1.7.7 found no new diagnostics; the same two existing `needs.pre-flight` errors occur on `main`.
- `BASE_REF=main CHECK_ONLY=true SKIP_DOCS=false bash tools/autoformat.sh` passed (no changed Python files).
- `git diff --check` passed.

detail.title: ci: Fail linting on training imports from Megatron Core

files.patch:
@@ -532,6 +532,17 @@ jobs:
         run: |
           uv sync --locked --only-group linting
 
+      - name: Check core does not import training
+        # Resolve relative imports through the megatron namespace package.
+        run: >-
+          .venv/bin/ruff check megatron/core
+          --isolated
+          --select TID251
+          --ignore-noqa
+          --output-format github
+          --config 'namespace-packages = ["megatron"]'
+          --config 'lint.flake8-tidy-imports.banned-api = {"megatron.training" = {msg = "megatron.core must not depend on megatron.training."}}'
+
       - name: Test CI cache keys
         run: .github/scripts/test_cache_keys.sh
